# Requirements Engineering Skill

## Purpose
Create a clear, testable, change-controlled requirements baseline.

## Requirement classes
- `BR-*`: business requirement/rule.
- `FR-*`: functional requirement.
- `NFR-*`: non-functional/quality attribute.
- `CON-*`: constraint or compliance condition.
- `AC-*`: acceptance criterion.
- `OUT-*`: explicit out-of-scope item.

## Quality checks
Requirements must be necessary, singular, unambiguous, feasible, consistent, traceable and verifiable. Avoid solution detail unless it is a real constraint. Quantify performance, reliability, security and usability claims.

## Required fields
ID, statement, rationale/source, priority, status, owner, dependencies, assumptions, acceptance criteria and verification method.

## Gate
Do not baseline until conflicts, unresolved high-impact questions and untestable requirements are surfaced and a human explicitly approves the version.
